import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_98/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_98/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Perform join on 'CLUES' column
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="CLUES", how="inner")

# Group by 'MOTATE_V' from source0 and sum the 'count' from source0
result = joined.groupby("MOTATE_V", as_index=False)["count"].sum()

# Ensure the 'MOTATE_V' column is string type and 'count' is integer type
result["MOTATE_V"] = result["MOTATE_V"].astype(str)
result["count"] = result["count"].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_98/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
